title: zephyranthes entreriana
intro: Zephyranthes entreriana, commonly known as the "Hooded Zephyr Lily" or "River Zephyr", is a flowering plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Zephyranthes entreriana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities.
